title: VTC: define in-call ephemeral WebSocket events
description: The draft defines VTCRingEvent and VTCCallEndEvent but nothing for in-call state changes. Without ephemeral events for participant join/leave, media state changes, and recording state changes, clients must poll via VTCCall/changes+get — too slow for real-time call UI. Define VTCParticipantEvent, VTCMediaStateEvent, VTCRecordingStateEvent, and register them as new dataTypes in ChatStreamEnable (or a VTC-specific stream-enable). The WSS spec's forward-compat rule (unknown @type silently ignored) makes this clean.
close_reason: Defined VTCParticipantEvent, VTCMediaStateEvent, VTCActiveSpeakerEvent, VTCUnmuteRequestEvent, and VTCRecordingStateEvent as ephemeral WebSocket events. Added subscription via ChatStreamEnable dataTypes vtc.
